_meta.description: Maps optimizer systems to bay study DB systems and holds the design values the DB stores only as text. Spec sections 2.3 and 4.5; docs/ASSUMPTIONS.md.
_meta.systems: Each entry under 'systems' is one uniform structural system. 'family' is the output system it competes in (steel, concrete, mass_timber); a family runs when it has at least one system here and an entry under 'columns'. Concrete has four systems that each compete over the whole building (decisions log).
_meta.materials: db_systems 'material' picks how a row is weighed and priced: steel (default), concrete, mass_timber.

mass_timber.label: CLT on glulam beams and girders

steel.cladding_note: Perimeter cladding line load per framed level (plf of perimeter). 0 for the hackathon; a warning says so.

concrete.target_note: phiPn,max already carries the 0.80 accidental-eccentricity factor, so Pu/phiPn,max <= 1.0 (ASSUMPTIONS COLC-2).
concrete.note: Square tied column, phiPn,max = 0.80*0.65*[0.85 f'c (Ag - Ast) + fy Ast] (spec 4.5). One size up the full height. Slenderness ignored and flagged. Flat plates use at least the DB column size (punching) and flag it when axial sizing needs larger.

mass_timber.grade_note: Placeholder, about DF glulam combination 2 (decisions log). Verify against NDS Supplement Table 5B for the grade specified.
mass_timber.note: Square glulam, NDS LRFD: Fc' = Fc KF phi lambda Cp, Emin' = Emin KF phi_s, NDS 3.7.1 Cp with c = 0.9, le = story height, le/d <= 50. One size up the full height. Preliminary; flagged in warnings.

scoring.note: Added to the 0..1 weighted score per bay (spec 4.3, 4.4: penalize, never remove). Both exceed any score difference, so a clean candidate always ranks first; an infeasible bay weighs as much as 100 bays over depth. docs/ASSUMPTIONS.md S-2.

STL_COMP.source: DB assumptions table, STL_COMP: 'Design SDL 15.0 psf'; 'Slab + deck weight 69.0 psf (verify against Vulcraft 2VLI table for gauge used)'

STL_ROOF_W.source: DB assumptions table, STL_ROOF_W: 'Roof dead load 15.0 psf superimposed'. Deck weight read per row from ref_roof_deck_spans.

STL_ROOF_J.source: DB assumptions table, STL_ROOF_J: 'Roof dead load 15.0 psf superimposed'. Deck weight read per row from ref_roof_deck_spans.

CONC_RC_FP.source: DB assumptions CONC_RC_FP: f'c 5,000 psi NW (150 pcf); 'SDL 15 psf floors / 20 psf roof'; columns square, sized by longer span. No vibration rows. Fallback = 12 in. slab.

CONC_PT_FP.source: DB assumptions CONC_PT_FP: as CONC_RC_FP. No vibration rows. Fallback = 10 in. slab.

CONC_OW_PTB.source: DB assumptions CONC_OW_PTB: office SDL 15, roof snow SDL 20; span_1 = PT beam span, span_2 = slab span = column spacing. No vibration rows. Fallback = 10 in. equivalent.

CONC_PAN.source: DB assumptions CONC_PAN: office SDL 15, roof snow SDL 20; 4.5 in. top slab. No vibration rows. Fallback = 8 in. equivalent.

MT_FLOOR.source: DB assumptions MT_FLOOR: 'Dead: CLT + 3" NW concrete topping (37.5 psf) + 10.0 psf MEP/ceiling/finishes'; CLT self-weight 20.6 psf; glulam 35 pcf. slab_deck_psf = 20.6 + 37.5. Fallback adds about 8 psf of glulam.

MT_ROOF.source: DB assumptions MT_ROOF: 'Dead: CLT + 15.0 psf roofing/insulation/MEP'; CLT 20.6 psf; glulam 35 pcf. Fallback adds about 4 psf of glulam.
